known_unsupported_special_sessions_evide.circular: NSE/CMTR -- Live trading sessions from Disaster Recovery (DR) site
known_unsupported_special_sessions_evide.note: Confirmed LIVE (not mock) split-window session: 09:15-10:00 and 11:30-12:30 IST, intra-day Primary-to-DR-site switchover, real trades and settlement obligations. The calendar model represents one continuous open/close window per day and cannot faithfully express a mid-session gap; deliberately excluded rather than distorted or flattened into a false continuous session. See the 2026-08-22 calendar-contract review.
